A1.toleranceLimitation: The Samtec footprint specifies nominal 1.02 mm holes. Its marketing drawing labels the 0.025 inch square terminal as reference. No finished-hole or terminal cross-section tolerance has been established here. Confirm finished plated-hole limits, purchased module holes, pin tolerance, seating, and solder access before fabrication or assembly.
A1.stackLimitation: Post and tail dimensions are nominal. Module thickness and maximum component height remain unmeasured; the enclosure records its proposed stack separately.
A1.moduleFitRequirement: The Samtec strips are a carrier-side candidate, not a validated fit for the purchased WeAct V3.0 module. A 0.635 mm nominal square pin has a 0.898026 mm diagonal; a 0.9 mm module hole would leave only 0.001974 mm nominal diametral clearance before tolerances. Measure the purchased module finished holes and establish pin cross-section/tolerance, hole tolerance, plating and insertion fit before assembly. Keep the carrier nominal holes at 1.02 mm.

displayBacklight.interface: active-high transistor base control through on-module 1 kOhm R5
displayBacklight.circuit: U2 NPN_SOT23 sinks four LED cathodes through four 39 Ohm resistors. R6 10 kOhm pulls its base to VCC. Emitter is GND. LCD LED anode is VCC.
displayBacklight.scope: Applies to the linked Waveshare module schematic, not a bare ILI9341 panel or arbitrary breakout. Module regulator and backlight current margin remain unmeasured.

J1.drawingScope: JST manufacturer catalog; the explicit 0.5 mm square-terminal drawing is the older manufacturer PDF mirrored by Pololu. Current JST catalog gives 3.4 mm as a reference tail dimension. Pin/kink tolerances are not established here.
J1.fabricationRequirement: For the planned plated glass-epoxy carrier, require 0.85-0.90 mm FINISHED PTH diameter for all eight J1 holes. The 0.875 mm KiCad/Excellon diameter is a nominal design target, not a measured finished hole or a prescribed pre-plating drill. Fabricator must choose drill compensation and confirm finished-hole, positional and annular-ring tolerances before manufacture.
J1.matingLimitation: Use the specified PHR-8 carrier-end housing with compatible JST contacts. The Waveshare included cable is not established as a PH-to-PH harness. Re-termination of its controller end is required; identify each conductor by continuity to the LCD signal and verify cavity orientation. The purchased LCD-end housing, crimp, wire dimensions, exit/bend radius and strain relief remain unmeasured.

controls.carrierPadMapping: At the shown top-view orientation, Omron 4-3 form the upper 6.5 mm row (KiCad pad 1 / GPIO); Omron 2-1 form the lower row (KiCad pad 2 / GND). The carrier footprint numbers are two electrical common groups, not four Omron terminal numbers.
controls.fabricationRequirement: Use the centered 1.0 mm nominal hole target and verify 0.9-1.1 mm finished holes and the stated non-accumulated pattern positions. Manufacturer PCB processing dimensions are reference values; final solder process and finished-hole capability remain to be confirmed.
controls.fitLimitation: Applies only to B3F-1000. Generic 6 mm tactile alternatives are unsupported until their drawings are checked. The drawing general tolerance is not sufficient to establish a purchased-pin worst-case fit.

LCD1.status: required assembly operation; not built or continuity-tested
LCD1.assemblyMethod: Retain the supplied LCD-end plug. Remove the controller-end individual GPIO sockets and re-terminate into one JST PHR-8 housing using eight new compatible contacts. Confirm the actual wire dimensions before choosing/crimping contacts; do not reuse an incompatible crimp. A sourced custom replacement must meet the same signal continuity and verified mating requirements.

lcdEnd.schematicConnector: J2 (8 signal contacts; J1 parallel header has the same numbered signals)

LCD1.orientationRequirement: Identify pin 1 from the actual header/housing marks and mounting/mating-face drawings. Do not infer pin numbers from left-to-right viewing direction or wire colors. The numerical map is the required endpoint connectivity, not evidence that an off-the-shelf cable is straight-through.
LCD1.acceptanceCheck: With both ends disconnected and unpowered, verify all eight specified end-to-end connections and isolation between all other conductors. Then verify VCC/GND polarity against the actual carrier and LCD pin labels before mating. Record the completed harness pinout.
LCD1.lengthAndRoutingLimitation: 200 mm is the supplied cable length, not a validated enclosure routing length. Route or shorten the harness only after a dry assembly confirms slack, wire exit, bend radius and strain relief. The CAD wire-exit reservation is not a manufacturer bend specification.
